text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa heads to the hospital room 
with a solemn expression. In her eyes lies 
an unwavering resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was the one who would carry Japan's 
colors—to do that, she had to stand above 
every other Umamusume aiming for the 
representative spot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Nakayama Festa boldly declares that 
she will win the upcoming Representative 
Exchange Race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was a quiet declaration of war from 
Nakayama Festa to <chrname>.
